title: Hatsune Miku — Powerful Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The Hanetsuki battle was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! The match between you and MEIKO versus Rin and Len at the end was so exciting!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Both pairs were like well-oiled machines and every rally lasted really long.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I like how you guys split into the front and back players. It felt very strategic with everyone calling out plays.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I noticed that too...
Have you guys played Hanetsuki before?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nope. It was our first time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I suppose we approached it like a badminton or tennis match. What do you think, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd say so.
It translated into Hanetsuki rather well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I see! But if you two were competing against each other, I wonder who'd win.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm curious about that too.
Why don't you two play against each other?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's alright.
I've had my fill of excitement.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Same here. Besides, I'd rather not have my face get all covered in ink...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Aww! You're no fun...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I guess we can get rid of the remaining ink then?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. We don't really have any use for it so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I don't think that's true.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Didn't you mention something about calligraphy and writing out what you want to do this year?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you mean New Year's resolutions?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Resolutions?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You think of what you want to achieve during the new year and write it with a calligraphy brush on a piece of paper.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
But calligraphy sounds kinda tough.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. But it'd be something new for us to try!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane, could you show us how it's done?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh, me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to see an example before I try it myself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes. Please show us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. I'm not very good at calligraphy, but I'll give it my best shot!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you're doing it, so am I!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And how about you two?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll pass.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same. We wouldn't have enough ink for everyone anyway.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, alright. Now, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! MEIKO, can we use this table?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure, but put this paper underneath so the wood doesn't get stained.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We'll do that. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, what do we do now...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hold the brush like this, dip it in the ink and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Write each character very carefully. Make sure to write straight lines decisively, like this... And curved lines with a bit of finesse, like this...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow! That looks awesome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And I like the word you chose.
Challenge.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I chose it because I want to challenge myself to become as good at singing as everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But to do that, I have to gain experience by taking the initiative.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That makes sense. Nice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If that's what Kohane is going with, I know what to pick.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Forward...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Now that I have the most awesome partner, and friends to match, all we have to do is to keep moving towards our goal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I like your resolution too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, it's our turn now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry, Kohane. Can you show me again how to hold the brush?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure. Hold it like this and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. They're really enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They really are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
How about you, Akito, Toya?
What are your New Year's resolutions?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Resolutions, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For me, it's... Determination.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like sticking with it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. My dad disapproves, but I've made up my mind about singing with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to keep performing with you, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice! That's great!
And what about you, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess I don't have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mine is... Victory. What happened at STAY GOLDEN is still nagging at me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I want to compete in another battle.
And get a better result this time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll keep my fingers crossed.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see no one here's lacking any ambition.
I'm sure another exciting year awaits us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I think so too!
